Upstream iterates `scriptloader.addons`. The agent looks up each Script by name, `"scriptmanager:" + path`, for each path in `opts.scripts`. result:
`--options` now loads any pending `-s` scripts before it dumps the option list, so options registered by addon scripts show up in the output. I haven't run it or the test suite, and I didn't add a test because `main.run` is marked `# pragma: no cover`.

Script options were missing because scripts register them in `Script.loadscript()`, and `Script.watcher()` defers that call until after startup. `--options` dumps and exits before the watcher ever loads the scripts.

The fix is in `mitmproxy/tools/main.py`, in the `args.options` branch. It goes through each path in `opts.scripts`, looks up the `Script` addon with `master.addons.get("scriptmanager:" + path)`, and calls `loadscript()` on any that haven't loaded yet. This runs just before `optmanager.dump_defaults`.

Loading here still goes through `loadscript()`, so import errors are reported the same way as at normal startup. Running the scripts early has no side effects for the `--options` path, because the process exits right after the dump.
